title: Careers
seo_title: Careers | Join Grow Green Weed Control – Lawn Treatment Jobs in Louisiana
seo_desc: Join the firefighter-owned team at Grow Green Weed Control! Explore rewarding lawn treatment and customer service careers across South Louisiana with great pay and growth opportunities.
headings: Good work. Real responsibility. A team that notices.
Find the role that fits you.
A small team with high standards.
paragraphs: Careers at Grow Green
Build a career with a firefighter-owned lawn treatment company trusted across South Louisiana. We train good people, reward strong performance, and take pride in doing the job right.
Current opportunities
Open positions and pay are updated directly by our hiring team, so what you see here is current.
You will be trusted to own your work, communicate clearly, and take care of customers as if their lawn were your own.
Handle your responsibilities confidently while knowing the team is available when something needs attention.
Whether you are treating lawns or supporting routes, your effort is visible in the customer experience.
Quality, reliability, efficiency, and follow-through are recognized—not lost inside a huge company.
Learn practical systems, sharpen your judgment, and earn greater responsibility as the company grows.
Eligible full-time positions may include health, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. Eligibility varies by position and will be confirmed during the hiring process.
Give us a clear picture of your experience and availability. If there is a fit, our team will contact you about the next step.
Choose an open role and complete the short application. A résumé is helpful but optional.
Our hiring team reviews your application, experience, availability, and role-specific answers.
If your background matches the role, we will contact you to discuss the opportunity and next steps.
The application is broken into three short steps and usually takes only a few minutes.
Fields marked with * are required.
Choose your position and tell us how to reach you.

Careers at Grow Green

Good work. Real responsibility. A team that notices.

Build a career with a firefighter-owned lawn treatment company trusted across South Louisiana. We train good people, reward strong performance, and take pride in doing the job right.

See open positions ↓ Apply now
Loading current openings…
  • Local routes
  • Hands-on training
  • Performance rewarded
Specialized workWe treat lawns—we are not a landscaping or mowing crew.
Competitive payCurrent ranges appear with each open position.
Production commissionStrong field performance can earn more.
Paid trainingLearn our standards, tools, and lawn program.
Room to advanceBuild skill, ownership, and responsibility.

Current opportunities

Find the role that fits you.

Open positions and pay are updated directly by our hiring team, so what you see here is current.

A small team with high standards.

You will be trusted to own your work, communicate clearly, and take care of customers as if their lawn were your own.

Quality, reliability, efficiency, and follow-through are recognized—not lost inside a huge company.

Learn practical systems, sharpen your judgment, and earn greater responsibility as the company grows.
